newsitem.title: USA: LogiMetrics says it won't restate results.
newsitem.headline: LogiMetrics says it won't restate results.

text.p: LogiMetrics Inc said Tuesday that based on an internal investigation it has determined it "is not appropriate ... to amend any of its previously filed financial statements."

The internal investigation was prompted by allegations lodged in June by its former chairman, president and chief executive that the company had overstated its revenues and earnings in previous periods.
The executive, Richard Laird, was on the job for less than three months when he resigned on May 31 from the microwave transmitting systems maker.
The internal investigation was prepared by Kirkpatrick & Lockhart LLP, which retained Deloitte & Touche LLP to assist it with the probe.
LogiMetrics said it expects to announce its fourth quarter results next week. The quarter ended June 30.
